title: Software Dev Engineer I
text:
Company Description
Swiggy is a leading technology platform that connects consumers, restaurant partners, and delivery partners. Our engineering teams build and operate scalable systems that power our diverse businesses and enable seamless, reliable operations.
We are looking for motivated engineers to join our Supply Chain engineering team as Backend Software Development Engineers I (SDE I). This role offers an opportunity to build technology that supports supply chain and fulfilment operations, solve real-world engineering challenges, and work with experienced engineers in a fast-paced environment.
Job Description
Position Overview
As a Backend Software Development Engineer I (SDE I) in the Supply Chain team, you will contribute to building and scaling reliable backend systems that support supply chain operations, inventory management, fulfilment, and operational workflows. You will develop backend services and APIs that enable efficient, accurate, and scalable business operations.
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to technical design and implementation, take ownership of well-defined engineering problems, and participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements to deploying and maintaining production systems.
What qualities are we looking for?
Strong Computer Science Fundamentals: A solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Operating Systems, and Database Management Systems.
Backend Engineering Skills: Hands-on experience with Go (Golang) and an understanding of backend application development, RESTful APIs, and service-oriented architecture.
System Design Fundamentals: Understanding of low-level design, modular coding practices, design patterns, and the fundamentals of building scalable and maintainable backend applications.
Database and Messaging Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. Exposure to NoSQL databases, caching solutions such as Redis, and messaging systems such as Kafka or SQS is an advantage.
Engineering Tools and Practices: Familiarity with Git, debugging, automated testing, and code reviews. Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Linux/Unix environments, and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP is beneficial.
GenAI Comfort: Willingness to use generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and documentation, while validating outputs for correctness, security, and quality.
Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, demonstrated through professional experience, coding challenges, open-source contributions, or practical engineering projects.
Ownership and Collaboration: A proactive approach, attention to code quality, effective communication, and the ability to collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams.
 
Preferred: Experience or exposure to supply chain, logistics, fulfilment, inventory management, warehouse operations, workforce management, e-commerce, or operations technology.
What will you get to do here?
Build Scalable Backend Systems: Develop, test, and maintain reliable backend services that support supply chain and fulfilment operations.
Develop APIs and Services: Build robust RESTful APIs and backend services, contribute to low-level design, and develop modular, maintainable solutions.
Support Supply Chain Workflows: Contribute to systems and workflows related to inventory, order processing, fulfilment, warehouse operations, and operational efficiency, based on business requirements.
Contribute to End-to-End Development: Translate business requirements into technical solutions, write production-ready code, and contribute to deployment and maintenance.
Maintain Engineering Excellence: Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, follow engineering best practices, and maintain high standards of code quality and reliability.

title: Associate Software Development Engineer
text:
Company Description
We are looking for highly motivated individuals to join our engineering team as Associate Software Development Engineers. As an ASDE, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of backend systems at scale. You will gain hands-on experience with technologies such as Java, Go, ElastiCache, Elasticsearch, Kafka, SQS, DynamoDB, and other modern engineering tools.
Job Description
Position Overview
The Associate Software Development Engineer role at Swiggy is the entry point into our engineering team for high-potential builders who are not yet at the SDE I level but have already shown they can ship. We solve consumer problems and build new products at scale by leveraging modern engineering and AI tools, and we are looking for candidates who bring strong computer science fundamentals, high curiosity, high energy, and very high ownership.
You won't be expected to have production experience at scale yet. What you will be expected to have is proof that you build things: PoCs, AI experiments, hackathon projects, side projects, or other hands-on work that you can demo and talk about in depth. As an ASDE, you will learn what it takes to turn an idea or experiment into a production-ready system, working alongside engineers who do this every day.
Specifically looking for:
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tooling: Experience experimenting with AI agents, prompt-driven workflows, or LLM-powered features using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, or directly working with provider APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic Claude.
Strong portfolio of things you've built: PoCs, AI experiments, side projects, hackathon projects, or other hands-on work. You should be able to demo what you've built, explain the problem you were solving, the approach you took, and key learnings.
Hands-on backend engineering experience: Experience building backend systems or services, with an understanding of how to design, develop, debug, and scale them with minimal supervision.
What qualities are we looking for?
Minimum 6 months of internship experience at a startup or a fast-paced product company.
Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and databases.
Proficiency in at least one programming language - Java, or Golang.
High curiosity: you dig into how things work, ask why, and learn new tools and technologies on your own without being asked.
High energy and very high ownership: you take a problem and run with it end to end, ask for help when blocked but never wait to be told what to do next, and care about the outcome, not just completing the task.
Comfortable with Linux/Unix environments and basic Git workflows.
A team player who communicates clearly, takes feedback well, and learns fast.
What will you get to do here?
Build and ship features and backend systems that solve real problems for millions of users.
Design, develop, and contribute to systems that operate at scale, with a focus on reliability, performance, and engineering quality.
Take your PoCs and ideas beyond the demo and learn what it takes to make them production-ready through testing, monitoring, reliability, and scale.
Work hands-on with modern engineering and AI tools to solve consumer problems and build new products.
Own small but real pieces of the system end to end, with the expectation that your scope grows as fast as you do.
Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing.
Grow into an SDE I role by demonstrating ownership, engineering quality, and impact.
Qualifications
B.Tech, 2025/2026 graduates with academic knowledge in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Additional Information
Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes

title: iOS Engineer - Creative App
text:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an iOS Engineer to join our growing mobile team and build the Creative App (iOS https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elevenlabs-ai-voice-generator/id6743162587), bringing our audio AI to millions of users. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most.

You’re impact-driven and autonomous, and good at drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. You’ll work closely with design, product and research, and help shape the app’s architecture and technical direction.

Requirements

 - Strong native iOS development (Swift, SwiftUI) with a track record of shipping features that improved engagement

 - Have designed and run A/B tests, using data to decide what to build next

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, and able to add structure where it’s needed

 - Experience owning performance, quality and responsiveness in a production app

Bonus

 - Experience with audio playback or streaming on iOS

 - Experience building mobile infrastructure for build, test and release pipelines

Location

text:
System/Software Engineer

  This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
In the HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what's next for you.

The Customer Focused Testing team is seeking a Senior Systems/Software Engineer who thrives in a challenging, fast-paced environment. This position focuses on testing HPE storage products, evaluating application feasibility with HPE storage solutions, and reproducing customer issues in customer-like environments to help accelerate debugging and resolution. You will be part of a highly dynamic team.

What you will do:
Responsibilities: 
Champion customer-focused testing practices, advocate for issue resolution, and influence product quality by ensuring the customer’s point of view is represented in decision-making.
Design, implement, and execute customer-focused tests for data storage product offering.
Rapidly gain expertise in external applications and validate integration feasibility with HPE storage products to deliver robust end-to-end solutions. 
Collaborate with the Customer Engineering and Escalation teams to understand customer issues. Perform targeted testing to reproduce problems and work with development to accelerate their debugging and resolution. 
Analyze test results, debug failures, and drive issues to resolution by collaborating with development, QA, product management, and customer support teams. 
Understand, participate, and provide input for functional and design specs and other design documentation.
Collaborate with other cross-functional teams, including but not limited to Product Management, Solution Engineering, Customer Support, and Platform Engineering.
Influence product quality by identifying test coverage gaps, raising defects, and shifting information left to upstream test organizations.
Document test strategies, workflows, and results; provide clear recommendations to engineering and leadership.

What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required: 
BS/MS degree in Science or Engineering from a recognized and accredited university/college.
Ideal candidates will have at least 10+ years of relevant experience.

Knowledge and Skills: 
Deep expertise in storage protocols (FC, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, S3) to ensure robust and scalable solutions.
Hands-on experience with cloud, storage, and networking technologies, including File and Object storage, Kubernetes, and related ecosystems.
Proficient in virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM) and enterprise backup solutions.
Exceptional debugging and problem-solving skills for complex, distributed system environments.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, with a keen eye for detail and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
Designing software systems running on multiple platform types.
Software systems testing methodology, including writing and execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language. Ability to effectively communicate design proposals and negotiate options.
